title: Nitrogen load in the Mississippi River watershed vs the 1950s (index)
geography: Mississippi River watershed (41% of the continental US)

source.name: Research on Mississippi River nutrient loading and Gulf hypoxia
source.publisher: USGS / university nutrient-runoff research, via Investigate Midwest

notes: Index where the 1950s nitrogen load in the Mississippi River watershed = 100. Nitrogen levels have roughly tripled since then (to ~300), driven largely by fertilizer runoff from Midwest farmland; the watershed drains roughly 41% of the continental United States into the Gulf.
